title: My wedding day heros
text:

I had originally hired the Straws n berries team to set up charcuterie boards for my wedding, but then realised id need some help on the day to sort out breakfast/lunch and drinks, so I enquired to see if I could hire them to help out for the day. author: D1107QWlouisec

title: Hen party picnic & catamaran boat trip
text:
Used this company for two activities 
1) Grazing picnic for hen party
2) Private catamaran trip 

Honestly can't recommend enough!!! The decor was beautiful, the food was delicious and such a cute activity for a hen party. Same with the boat so beautifully decorated and we had more snacks/drinks ready for this too. 

Only suggestion is avoid boat trip in March/ if the water is feeling quite choppy - quite a few of the girls felt sea sick so we couldn't enjoy it properly. I think it's a really fun and fab activity, so you should definitely do but just time it well :)
author: 594sumanar

title: Picnic bachelor party
text: Fantastic concept! Was perfectly dressed in theme of your choice, artisan delicacies and beverage. An absolute must for all your festivities! Communication very smooth and correct. Super sweet people! Lovely people who consider your people:-) All go there for a fantastic experience 👌🏼
author: DoraV414

title: Perfect girly afternoon
text:
I used Straws n Berries in May 2019 for my cousins Hen Du and it was incredible! Babet was a brilliant host and she was super responsive. It was the perfect surprise and girly afternoon. 
I am heading back to Barcelona in October and have already messaged her as I'd love to do this again. The food and drinks were very tasty also!
author: Guranisha

title: Very professional
text: Unfortunately we had to cancel our trip from London to Barcelona because of the corona virus. I just wanted to say a big thank you to Straws n' Berries for dealing with this in the most professional way. I to work in events and I know what a hard time we are all having and will have in the next couple of months. For such a small company to give me a voucher is very much appreciated as I thought I had lost my money all together. Thank you to both Babet and Maike for being so helpful and professional. Rest assured once this is over I will be re booking, but moreover I will keep recommending you

title: Great group event
text:

title: A MUST DO!!!!

title: Excited to get booked back in when we next can!
text:

title: Kind & understanding!
text:
We had a picnic booked for next month, but due to the Carona Virus our flights got cancelled and so did all the activities we had booked in Barcelona, Straws 'n Berries were the only company who wrote us a really nice email and gave us a voucher to use for the FULL amount with no expiry date and to use by anyone.
This is very generous baring in mind they are a small business and must have had a really hard time with all the events being cancelled. 

Thank you girls and good luck this season!
